arbitrary_prompt_smoke.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.
arbitrary_prompt_smoke.end_to_end_scope: Process start through tokenization, text encoding, transformer loading and denoising, VAE setup and decode, and completed PNG output

startup_optimization.prompt: A blue ceramic teapot on a windowsill.
startup_optimization.scope: Fresh process through completed PNG output with a warm macOS filesystem cache
changes: Reuse the pipeline's already-tokenized IDs instead of parsing tokenizer assets twice
Issue advisory MADV_WILLNEED for the four text-encoder mappings before Metal setup
Keep structural QIPACK validation mandatory but make its full payload checksum scan explicit
startup_optimization.checksum_policy: Structure, identity, inventory, layout, and ranges are always checked. QI_VERIFY_PACKED_CHECKSUMS=1 checks all tensor hashes during load; verify-packed checks tensor and whole-payload hashes.
startup_optimization.memory_tradeoff: Text-shard readahead increased maximum RSS by about 4.24 GB in the controlled A/B; madvise is advisory and does not affect correctness.

two_query_attention_optimization.interpretation: The isolated 9.3% attention gain translates to 0.207 s wall in Cache-DiT because only 13 steps execute all 32 blocks and cached steps execute block 0 only.

validation.reason: Cache-DiT intentionally changes the denoising trajectory; metrics are reported for product-quality review rather than accepted under the exact cache-off oracle.

interpretation: Both thresholds exceed the requested speed target at 256px. Threshold 0.24 reaches the three-consecutive-step cap throughout most of the schedule and is about 2.1 seconds faster than 0.12, while the canonical decoded and RGBA errors are nearly identical. Both remain explicit choices because one prompt cannot establish a universal perceptual-quality policy; cache-off remains the default and reproducible path.
